g.text: PROPOSED — explanatory Excalidraw view. The saved Jeeves design comes in Phase 1.
Solid arrow: request / read Dashed arrow: queued delivery Amber: product rule
Allowed + fresh → 302. Expired or blocked → stop.
A broker outage must not stop redirects. Analytics exposes freshness and coverage gaps.
Cloud placement, guest ownership and failure behavior each have a separate drawing. Nothing here is a deployment claim.
